data.name: Ashvik
data.gender_notes: Ashvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ash' and 'Vik'. 'Ash' represents the Himavat Mountain, which is considered sacred in Hindu mythology. 'Vik' means power. Thus, Ashvik can be interpreted as the one who possesses the power of the sacred Himavat Mountain. The name Ashvik carries the meaning “Ash (Himavat Mountain) + Vik (power)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashvik usually hope their child will grow to embody ash (himavat mountain) + vik (power) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes connection to the divine power and the strength to overcome challenges.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashvik total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
